mapper.sql: id, role_id, scope_code, catalog_name, database_name, table_name, column_name, accesses, created_at

p.id, p.role_id, p.scope_code, p.catalog_name, p.database_name, p.table_name, p.column_name, p.accesses, p.created_at, sc.name as scope_name, sc.plugin_type as plugin_type, sc.ranger_service_name as ranger_service_name, sc.enabled as scope_enabled
mapper.select: select from t_r_data_perm_role_permission p left join t_r_data_perm_scope sc on sc.code = p.scope_code where p.role_id = #{roleId}
